title: Chicken Dum Biryani from scratch 🍗🔥 Hyderabadi style #shorts

segments.moment_description: Arriving home with the biryani ingredients
Cooking the basmati rice and frying onions
Layering the chicken and rice in the pot
Slow dum-cooking the sealed biryani over fire
Serving and eating the fragrant dum biryani

description:
Chicken Dum Biryani 🍗🔥 — layered basmati rice and spiced marinated chicken, sealed and slow-cooked on dum till every grain is fragrant. The Hyderabadi classic, made from scratch.

Biryani with raita or salan — what's your combo? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Made with basmati rice, yogurt-marinated chicken, fried onions, mint, saffron and whole spices, cooked on slow dum.

Did you know? 'Dum' means slow-cooking in a sealed pot — trapping the steam is what lets the rice soak up all the aroma without ever drying out.
